title: India just raised $127 billion from its own diaspora
sources: Bloomberg, Sept 2, 2026 - India Raises Record $127 Billion in Foreign Currency Deposits From Diaspora
Bloomberg, Sept 3, 2026 - India's Record Diaspora Inflows Swamp Banks, Test RBI Tools
The Indian Eye, Sept 3, 2026 - India Mobilises $127 Billion in Diaspora Deposits to Boost Forex Reserves
caption:
This week, India raised more money from its own diaspora than most countries' entire annual budgets. Not remittances. Not investment. A direct call for deposits - and the diaspora answered.

The Reserve Bank's special foreign currency deposit scheme (FCNR-B) raised $127 billion from the diaspora in September 2026. Combined with other diaspora-linked foreign currency inflows, the total crossed $136 billion.

This is only the third time in India's history it has tapped diaspora deposits at this scale, after 1998's Resurgent India Bonds and 2000's India Millennium Deposits - each time during a moment of external pressure on the rupee, each time stabilized in part by the diaspora's own money.

This isn't foreign aid or foreign investment. It's Indians abroad lending their own country money and getting paid back. Nineteen million Indians live and work outside India and when it matters most, they're still the first call India makes.

Sources: Bloomberg (2026), The Indian Eye (2026)
